payload.name: Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch (Vonage deprecated)
payload.body:
# SMS reminders: switch to Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by the Weekly sync attendees (Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe).

## Decision
We will move SMS reminders from Vonage to **Sinch**, effective 2026-11-01. Vonage will be deprecated for SMS reminders.

## Why
Vonage delivery failures persist (including Portuguese numbers); Sinch was chosen as the replacement to improve delivery reliability.

## Notes
- Priya will redesign SMS templates for Sinch (see task).
- Kenji stopped the Vonage rollout and the Vonage rollout task is closed.

payload.note: Decision to replace Vonage with Sinch (agreed 2026-10-13)

payload.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)
payload.body:
# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU region)

Decided on 2026-10-14 by Tom Lindqvist and Maya Okafor.

## Decision
We will use **PostHog Cloud, EU region** for product analytics so clinic data remains in the EU while reducing operational overhead.

## Why
Self-hosting was consuming too much ops time; PostHog Cloud (EU) preserves data residency and reduces maintenance.

payload.note: Replace self-hosted PostHog with PostHog Cloud (agreed 2026-10-14)

payload.reason: Replaced by decision to use PostHog Cloud (Decision ID: 4704303c-42f0-4359-b528-4f419c56167a)

payload.name: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly releases (Tuesdays and Thursdays) behind feature flags
payload.body:
# Release cadence: twice-weekly (Tuesdays and Thursdays), behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-15 by Daniel Reyes and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
We will ship releases twice-weekly on **Tuesdays and Thursdays**, still protected by feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics; this schedule balances predictability and frequent delivery.

payload.note: Replace continuous deploys decision with twice-weekly schedule (agreed 2026-10-15)

payload.name: Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly with a metrics dashboard link
payload.body:
# Investor update cadence: monthly with metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by Maya Okafor.

## Decision
Investor updates will revert to **monthly** cadence. We will keep the metrics dashboard link in updates.

## Why
Brightpath requested we slow down the update cadence; keeping the dashboard link preserves access to metrics.

payload.note: Return investor update cadence to monthly with dashboard link (agreed 2026-10-16)

# Design system: shadcn/ui

Decided on 2026-10-16 by Priya Raman and Kenji Watanabe.

## Decision
We will replace the Tailwind UI kit with **shadcn/ui** as our design system.

## Why
Agreed by design leads to standardise on shadcn/ui for component primitives and developer ergonomics.
